PROFILE:
Proven expertise in managing projects from schematic design through to construction completion, encompassing project management, engineering, and supervision of superstructures and substructures.

Extensive experience in planning and constructing private estates, multi-family residential buildings, and
commercial, hospitality, educational, and mixed-use developments.

Strong skills in master planning and cost control, along with supervising construction activities, managing site logistics, and enforcing safety regulations.

Quick to adapt to new industry concepts and practices.

Proficient in budget preparation and forecasting.

A collaborative team player who values collective strength, while also capable of working independently to achieve desired outcomes.

Skilled in managing a demanding workload and maintaining attention to detail across multiple concurrent tasks, without losing sight of long-term goals.

Committed to OSHA standards and adept at developing risk mitigation strategies for site operations.

Knowledgeable in procurement procedures, contracts, and contract execution.

Familiar with curtain wall systems, including unitized and stick systems.

Broad experience in the complete fit-out of commercial, industrial, and hotel/resort projects.
